instruction: util.py has three public functions, process_admins, process_managers and process_engineers, that are copies of the same filter-and-normalize code and differ only in the role they select. Remove the duplication: the shared logic must live in a single private helper (a function whose name starts with '_') that takes the role as a parameter, and each public function must become a thin wrapper around it with no role comparison of its own. The public names, signatures and behaviour must not change. tests/test_util.py checks both the behaviour and the structure; don't modify it.
